en.stem: For both-bone forearm fracture with Gustilo IIIA open wound, treatment is:
options: Primary plate osteosynthesis following aggressive debridement and irrigation
External fixation only with delayed definitive fixation

bg.stem: AVN при изолирана фрактура на радиалната глава (Mason тип III) при възрастен се лекува със:

en.stem: Mason III isolated radial head fracture in an adult is treated by:
